scripts.build: tsc && echo '<!DOCTYPE html><html><body>agent-server</body></html>' > dist/index.html && mkdir -p output/bin && cp -r dist/* output/bin/ && cp -r node_modules output/bin/ && cp package.json output/bin/ && find output/bin/node_modules -name '*.map' -delete && find output/bin/node_modules -name '*.js.map' -delete && rm -rf output/bin/node_modules/convert-source-map output/bin/node_modules/source-map output/bin/node_modules/source-map-js output/bin/node_modules/vite && npm run build:skills && npm run build:config
scripts.build:skills: skills add larksuite/cli -s lark-doc -s lark-im -s lark-contact -s lark-base -s lark-drive -s lark-sheets -s lark-shared -y --copy && cp -r .agents/skills output/bin/.agent-skills
scripts.build:config: cp runtime/CLAUDE.md output/bin/.claude-global-md && cp config/skills.json output/bin/.skills-config.json
